folder.description: Only tasks in this folder are returned.

recursive.description: Also return tasks in the folder's subfolders.

tags_any.description: Only tasks with at least one of these tags (see Narrowing tasks).

tags_all.description: Only tasks with every one of these tags (see Narrowing tasks).

limit.description: At most this many tasks, the first in the operation's order; absent, no limit (see Narrowing tasks).

fields.description: Return each task as a Task projection of these fields, id always included; absent, whole Task views (see Narrowing tasks).
